tools.name: audit_ai_visibility
tools.description: Score how discoverable a website is by AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews) and AI agents. Returns a 0-100 score, per-category scores and a prioritized fix list.

tools.name: generate_ai_visibility_files
tools.description: Generate ready-to-publish llms.txt, an AI-bot-friendly robots.txt and schema.org JSON-LD for a website, based on its current homepage.
